title: Code indexer crashes gitea on i386/x86 with "panic: unaligned 64-bit atomic operation"
body:
### Description

On an i386 system gitea 1.17.3 runs perfectly.
Version 1.18.0-rc0 and 1.18.0-rc1 crashes when indexing code.

### Gitea Version

1.18.0-rc0 and 1.18.0-rc1

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

No

### Log Gist

_No response_
